def solve_alpha_w01_batch_04(dataset: dict) -> dict:
    train, test = dataset['train'], dataset['test']
    dt = np.asarray(dataset['past_dt'], float)
    time = np.asarray(dataset['eval_times'], float)
    sy = float(dataset['yield_stress'])
